li.label: they got away
li.description: The one who did this to me is out there, walking around, eating, sleeping. I keep seeing the face.

li.label: they came back
li.description: I knew it. I knew they'd come back. My hands won't stop shaking.

li.label: let them come
li.description: They came back. Good. This time I'm the one who knows what's coming.

li.label: my nemesis in chains
li.description: The one who hurt me sleeps behind a door I can lock. I walked past it twice today, just to hear it hold.

li.label: I had my revenge
li.description: It was me. At the end it was my hand. I thought I'd feel more. I feel lighter, which is close enough.

li.label: my nemesis is dead
li.description: Someone finished it. I wish it had been me, but I'll take dead over waiting.

li.label: ended someone's nightmare
li.description: That one had been haunting one of ours. Not anymore. People keep buying me drinks with their eyes.

li.label: my animal fought for me
li.description: When it went bad, my animal didn't run. It came straight at them. I owe it more than scraps.

li.label: lost my animal
li.description: I keep listening for it at the door. It was only an animal. That's what I keep telling myself.
